verdict.rationale: Typesense's own ranking-and-relevance guide documents ranking that combines relevance with popularity and with recency, plus boosting/burying records and merchandising. A hands-on commenter also praised the compact sort_by syntax, so the core of the story (business signals beyond text match) is a direct product capability. The evidence is only section headings, though, and margin is never mentioned; a critic's general view that it lacks Lucene-level tuning knobs is skepticism, not a concrete counter-example. missing for 10: explicit evidence for margin or arbitrary custom-field signals, detail on how ranking rules and signal weights are configured, independent hands-on corroboration of popularity/recency ranking quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can shape relevance with custom ranking rules and business signals (popularity, recency, margin) beyond textual matching

citations.quote: Ranking based on Relevance and Popularity ... Ranking based on Relevance and Recency
They also liked the compact filter_by/sort_by syntax with qualifiers.
